text.description_html:
TC611 ADA Compliant Grade 1 Tri Packed Door Closers

The Global TC611 Door Closer are our most economically priced full cover closer. They are recommended for use on commercial, architectural and institutional applications. Ideal for business, new construction and renovations. Available in Dark Bronze or Aluminum finishes.

Global Series TC611 Door Closers are tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm installations. They are non-handed and have individual adjustments for sweep speed, latch speed, and backcheck cushioning. They fit 11-3/32" x 3/4" mounting hole pattern and packaged complete with wood and machine screws.

Features and Specifications of the Global TC611 Grade 1 Overhead Door Closer:

  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable back check
  • Aluminum Alloy Shell
  • Horizontal Mounting Holes: 11-3/32"
  • Vertical Mounting Holes: 3/4"
  • Maximum Door Size: 60" interior / 48" exterior
  • Maximum Door Weight: 258 lbs
  • Spring Tension: Adjustable 1 - 6
  • Tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm mounting
  • Non Handed
  • Optional Hold Open
  • ADA Compliant
  • UL 10C Approved (UL R7483 615R)
  • Includes Full Plastic Cover
  • Includes Parallel Mounting Bracket
  • Grade 1 Certified
  • 25 Year Manufacture Warranty
  • TC600 Series Instructions

The TC611 is ADA Compliant offering adjustable spring power sizes 1 - 6 for use on interior doors requiring less than 5 lbs. of opening force and exterior doors requiring less than 8.5 lbs.

This closer can be ordered with the Standard Arm or Optional Hold Open Arm.
Also available other TC600 Series Closer Accessories
